tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card and panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, app bar, bottom tab bar, menus. Separated from `surface` by a `line` hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, switch track (off), zebra rows in Meterstanden, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards and dividers between rows. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons; chart axis line. 3.6:1 on `surface-raised` (light), 3.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and big numbers on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (≥14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units, captions, axis labels, secondary labels on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥5.9:1 light, ≥7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected segment, switch on, active tab, links. As text on `surface` / `surface-raised` ≥8:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Hover tint of quiet buttons, selected row, active tab pill background. Carries `brand` or `ink` text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill (8.9:1 light, 9.2:1 dark). Never literal white in dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with 2px `surface-raised` gap. ≥8:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-verbruik
tokens.usage: Verbruik (house consumption = opname + opwekking − teruglevering). Always drawn as a 2px LINE on top of the areas, never filled. 5.7:1 / 6.2:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: series-opname
tokens.usage: Opname (drawn from the grid). Area/bar ABOVE the zero axis. Darkest warm series so it separates from `series-teruglevering` by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: series-teruglevering
tokens.usage: Teruglevering (fed back to the grid). Area/bar BELOW the zero axis (negative), so direction — not hue alone — tells it from Opname.

tokens.name: series-opwekking
tokens.usage: Opwekking (solar). Area/bar above the axis, behind Opname. 3.8:1 on `surface-raised` light — a mark colour, not for body text.

tokens.name: series-gas
tokens.usage: Gas (m³ and gas €). Its own hue — never the Opname red. Only in the Gas chart and gas KPI.

tokens.name: tariff-dal-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Daltarief badge (moon icon).

tokens.name: tariff-dal-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon on `tariff-dal-bg` (8.2:1 / 8.3:1).

tokens.name: tariff-normaal-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Normaaltarief badge (sun icon).

tokens.name: tariff-normaal-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon on `tariff-normaal-bg` (6.1:1 / 8.9:1).

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Live dot of the LiveIndicator, always next to the word "Live". 5.4:1 / 8.2:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon ("Niet alle prijzen zijn bekend", data stale). On `status-warning-bg` 5.2:1 / 8.0:1.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Offline state, form errors, failed save — always with an icon and words. 6.6:1 / 6.5:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of error banners.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind menus and sheets on mobile.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The one Verbruik figure in the Nu-panel. Tabular figures. One per screen.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: KPI values (Vandaag), flow-node values, period totals.

styles.name: num-md
styles.usage: Secondary values: costs under a KPI, legend totals.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title (one per page, desktop). 20px on mobile via `title`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stel je tarieven in om kosten te zien.
styles.usage: Running text, form values, menu items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, selected segment, emphasised inline text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: KPI labels, field labels, legend items, badges.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Axis ticks, timestamps, helper text, deltas.

styles.name: meter
styles.usage: Meterstanden only — reads like the meter's own display. Right-aligned, units in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control group, legend item gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding (horizontal), gap between KPI tiles on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gap between cards on mobile, page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections, page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of page under the app bar (desktop), empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, segmented-control segments, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, banners, menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch, live dot, tab-bar active pill, flow-node rings.

shadow.note: Cards use a `line` hairline, not a shadow. Shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, date-range popover, the sticky save bar, chart tooltip.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls (desktop).

tokens.name: control-h-touch
tokens.usage: Same controls on touch / mobile.

tokens.name: appbar-h
tokens.usage: Desktop app bar height.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar height (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content on desktop.
